Access.name: ricercaContratti
Access.Query:
declare @numContr varchar(20) select @numContr =
numeroContratto
select distinct A.RETEVEND_C_RETE as codRete, L.AGE_C_AGE as codAge, A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE+' '+A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE as nominAge, A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanumAge, L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD as tipProd, @numContr as numContratto, (select CONTRPOLIZVITA_N_POLIZ from INR_CONTRPOLIZVITA where PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD) as numPolizza, L.PROD_C_PROD as codProd, M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanum, C.CLI_M_COGN as cliCognome, C.CLI_M_NOME as cliNome, L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR as numContrPolCompleto, case L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD when 'MT' then ( select count(*) from INR_CONTRMUTUI C , INR_STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI S where C.CONTRMUTUI_C_ATTO = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = S.PROD_C_PROD and C.CONTRMUTUI_C_STATO_PR = S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_C_STATO and (S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_F_TIPSTAT = 'C' or C.CONTRMUTUI_D_ESTIN is not null) ) when 'PR' then ( select count(*) from INR_PRESTITI C , INR_STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI S where C.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = S.PROD_C_PROD and C.PRESTITI_C_STATUS = S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_C_STATO and S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_F_TIPSTAT = 'C' ) else ( select count(*) from INR_CONTRPROD C , INR_STATOCONTR S where C.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR = S.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR and S.STATOCONTR_F_TIP_STATO_CONTR = 'C' ) end as isChiuso from INR_LEGAMECONTRCLI L, INR_CODIFCLIMEDL M, INR_CLI C, INR_AGENTI A where L.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL and M.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = C.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and C.AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR and A.AGE_C_AGE = C.AGE_C_AGE and A.AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR and ( L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = 'M001'+right((replicate('0',8)+@numContr),8) or L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = right((replicate('0',7)+@numContr),7) or L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = right((replicate('0',12)+@numContr),12) or L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = right((replicate('0',11)+@numContr),11) ) and L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR !=
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and 1 = 1
union all
select distinct A.RETEVEND_C_RETE as codRete, PV.AGE_C_AGE as codAge, A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE+' '+A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE as nominAge, A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanumAge, PV.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD as tipProd, PV.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR as numContratto, @numContr as numPolizza, PV.PROD_C_PROD as codProd, M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanum, C.CLI_M_COGN as cliCognome, C.CLI_M_NOME as cliNome, PV.CONTRPOLIZVITA_N_POLIZ as numContrPolCompleto, (select count(*) from INR_CONTRPROD C , INR_STATOCONTR S where C.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR = S.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR and S.STATOCONTR_F_TIP_STATO_CONTR = 'C' ) as isChiuso from INR_CONTRPOLIZVITA PV, INR_LEGAMECONTRCLI L, INR_CODIFCLIMEDL M, INR_CLI C, INR_AGENTI A where PV.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and L.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL and M.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = C.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and C.AGE_C_AGE = PV.AGE_C_AGE and A.AGE_C_AGE = C.AGE_C_AGE and A.AGE_C_AGE = PV.AGE_C_AGE and PV.AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR and ( PV.CONTRPOLIZVITA_N_POLIZ = right((replicate('0',11)+@numContr), 11) ) and PV.AGE_C_AGE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and PV.AGE_C_AGE !=
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and 1 = 1
order by 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10

Access.name: elencoContrattiCliente
Access.Query: select distinct A.RETEVEND_C_RETE as codRete, L.AGE_C_AGE as codAge, A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE+' '+A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE as nominAge, A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanumAge, L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD as tipProd, L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR as numContratto, (select max(CONTRPOLIZVITA_N_POLIZ) from INR_CONTRPOLIZVITA where CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE) as numPolizza, L.PROD_C_PROD as codProd, M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL as codMediolanum, C.CLI_M_COGN as cliCognome, C.CLI_M_NOME as cliNome, L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR as numContrPolCompleto, case L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD when 'MT' then ( select count(*) from INR_CONTRMUTUI C , INR_STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI S where C.CONTRMUTUI_C_ATTO = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = S.PROD_C_PROD and C.CONTRMUTUI_C_STATO_PR = S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_C_STATO and (S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_F_TIPSTAT = 'C' or C.CONTRMUTUI_D_ESTIN is not null) ) when 'PR' then ( select count(*) from INR_PRESTITI C , INR_STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI S where C.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = S.PROD_C_PROD and C.PRESTITI_C_STATUS = S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_C_STATO and S.STATO_MUTUI_PRESTITI_F_TIPSTAT = 'C' ) else ( select count(*) from INR_CONTRPROD C , INR_STATOCONTR S where C.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR = L.CONTRPROD_N_CONTR and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = L.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.PROD_C_PROD = L.PROD_C_PROD and C.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = S.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD and C.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR = S.STATOCONTR_C_STATO_CONTR and S.STATOCONTR_F_TIP_STATO_CONTR = 'C' ) end as isChiuso from INR_LEGAMECONTRCLI L, INR_CODIFCLIMEDL M, INR_CLI C, INR_AGENTI A where L.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = M.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL and M.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = C.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and C.AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR and A.AGE_C_AGE = C.AGE_C_AGE and A.AGE_C_AGE = L.AGE_C_AGE_CONTR and L.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = ? order by codAge, tipProd, numContratto, codProd, cliCognome, cliNome

Access.name: ricercaClienti
Access.Query:
select cli.cli_c ,cli.cli_x_cf ,cli.cli_n_piva ,case cli.cli_c_ncg when 'SFF' then CASE WHEN TRIM(cli.cli_c_sec_int) = '' THEN NULL ELSE cli.cli_c_sec_int END when 'SMM' then CASE WHEN TRIM(cli.cli_c_sec_int) = '' THEN NULL ELSE cli.cli_c_sec_int END else cli_m_cogn end ,case cli.cli_c_ncg when 'SFF' then cli.cli_m_cogn||' '||cli.cli_m_nom when 'SMM' then cli.cli_m_cogn||' '||+cli.cli_m_nom else cli_m_nom end ,cli.cli_d_nasc ,'P' AS retevend_c_rete ,age.age_c ,age.age_m_nome ,opvpromo_c_cli as codMediolanumAge from cll.cli cli inner join cll.cliage clia on clia.cli_c = cli.cli_c and clia.cliage_d_fine = to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd') inner join cll.age age on clia.age_c = age.age_c left outer join onl.opvpromo promo on promo.opvpromo_c_age = age.age_c where 1 = 1 and age.age_c =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and age.age_c !=
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and 1 = 1 and age.age_c =
codAgente and clia.cli_c =
codMediolanum and cli.cli_m_cogn LIKE
cognome% and cli.cli_m_nom LIKE
nome%
and cli.cli_m_nom LIKE 'A%'
union select null , cli.CLI_X_CF , cli.CLI_N_PIVA , cli.CLI_M_COGN , cli.CLI_M_NOME , cli.CLI_D_NASC , 'P' , age.age_c , age.age_m_nome , opvpromo_c_cli from cll.inr_cli_elettr_rep cli inner join cll.LEGM_PROSPCT_AGENT_COGEST legm on legm.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = cli.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and legm.cod_ruolo_agent='BC' and legm.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' inner join cll.age age on age.age_c = legm.cod_agent left outer join onl.opvpromo promo on promo.opvpromo_c_age = age.age_c where legm.cod_agent =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and cli.age_c_age =
codAgente and 1 = 2 and cli.cli_m_cogn like
cognome% and cli.cli_m_nome like
nome%
and cli.cli_m_nome like 'A%'
order by 4, 5

Access.name: ricercaAgenti
Access.Query:
declare @codAgente varchar(20) select @codAgente =
codAgente SELECT @codAgente = substring(@codAgente,patindex('%[^0]%',@codAgente),10) SELECT DISTINCT RIGHT('0000000000'||AN.COD_SOGGETTO,10) AS AGE_C_AGE, AN.DENOMINAZIONE, RIGHT('00000000000'||CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),DA.COD_CLI_AGENTE),11) AS CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL, 'P' AS RETEVEND_C_RETE, DE.COGNOME, DE.NOME FROM ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO AN INNER JOIN ARC_DATI_SOGGETTO DA ON 1=1 AND AN.N_ANAG_SOGG = DA.N_ANAG_SOGG INNER JOIN ARC_DETT_SOGGETTO DE ON 1=1 AND AN.N_ANAG_SOGG = DE.N_ANAG_SOGG INNER JOIN ARC_MOV_STRUTTURA MO ON 1=1 AND AN.N_ANAG_SOGG = MO.N_ANAG_SOGG AND GETDATE() BETWEEN MO.DT_DECORR_MOV and MO.DT_FINE_DECORR_MOV INNER JOIN ARC_STATO_SOGGETTO ST ON 1=1 AND MO.N_STATO_SOGG = ST.N_STATO_SOGG AND ST.DESCR_STATO_SOGG = 'ATTIVO' WHERE 1=1 AND AN.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' AND DA.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' AND DE.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' AND MO.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N' AND ST.FLG_ANNULLATO = 'N'
and AN.COD_SOGGETTO = @codAgente and DE.COGNOME like
cognome%
order by DE.COGNOME, DE.NOME

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoCC
Access.Query: SELECT NVL(C.DES_CATEG_CONTO,'') || ' - ' || NVL(S.DES_SCATEG_CONTO,'') || ' - ' || NVL(CC.DES_CONVZ_CONTO,'') FROM CLL.CONTR CB INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.DOM_CATEG_CONTO C ON C.COD_CATEG_CONTO = CB.CONTR_C_CAT LEFT JOIN CAT_PROD.DOM_SCATEG_CONTO S ON S.COD_SCATEG_CONTO = CB.CONTR_C_SCAT LEFT JOIN CAT_PROD.DOM_CONVZ_CONTO CC ON CC.COD_CONVZ_CONTO = CB.CONTR_C_CONV INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.DETT_PROD_TECN PROD_TECN ON PROD_TECN.PROD_C = CB.PROD_C WHERE CB.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND C.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND S.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND CC.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND PROD_TECN.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND PROD_TECN.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND CB.CONTR_N = ? AND CB.PROD_C = ?

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoDT
Access.Query: SELECT DES_TIPO_PROD_CONTR FROM CAT_PROD.DETT_PROD_TECN A INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.DOM_TIPO_PROD_CONTR B1 ON A.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = B1.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR WHERE A.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = 'DT' AND A.PROD_C = cast('12' as char(11))

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoGP
Access.Query: SELECT INR_PROD.PROD_X_PROD FROM INR_PROD WHERE INR_PROD.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD = ? AND INR_PROD.PROD_C_PROD = ?

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoAL
Access.Query: SELECT TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_X_DESCR_HOST ) FROM cll.PROD DBAZ INNER JOIN cat_prod.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT ON DPT.PROD_C = DBAZ.PROD_C WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND DBAZ.PROD_C = cast(? as char(11))

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoFO
Access.Query: SELECT NVL(TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_X_FAM) || ' ', '') FROM CLL.V_FAMPROD FAM , CLL.V_COMPFAMPROD COMP , CLL.PROD DBAZ , CAT_PROD.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND TRIM(COMP.FAMPROD_C_FAM) = TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_C_FAM) AND TRIM(COMP.PROD_C_PROD) = TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_C) AND TRIM(COMP.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD) = TRIM(DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR) AND TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_C) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) AND TRIM(COMP.PROD_C_PROD) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) AND DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND DBAZ.PROD_C = cast(? as char(11))

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoPD
Access.Query: SELECT NVL(TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_X_FAM) || ' ', '') FROM CLL.V_FAMPROD FAM , CLL.V_COMPFAMPROD COMP , CLL.PROD DBAZ , CAT_PROD.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND TRIM(COMP.FAMPROD_C_FAM) = TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_C_FAM) AND TRIM(COMP.PROD_C_PROD) = TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_C) AND TRIM(COMP.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD) = TRIM(DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR) AND TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_C) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) AND TRIM(COMP.PROD_C_PROD) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) AND DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND DBAZ.PROD_C = cast(? as char(11))

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoPV
Access.Query: SELECT TEMP.DESCRIZIONE FROM (SELECT DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR, DBAZ.PROD_C, nvl(TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_X_FAM), '') || ' ' || TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_X_DESCR_HOST) AS DESCRIZIONE FROM CLL.V_FAMPROD FAM INNER join CLL.V_COMPFAMPROD COMP ON TRIM(COMP.FAMPROD_C_FAM) = TRIM(FAM.FAMPROD_C_FAM) INNER JOIN CLL.PROD DBAZ ON TRIM(COMP.PROD_C_PROD) = TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_C) INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT ON TRIM(COMP.TIPPROD_C_TIP_PROD) = TRIM(DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR) INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.ANAG_POL_VITA APV ON trim(APV.COD_PROD_POL_VITA) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND nvl(TRIM(APV.FLG_PREVD), 'N') != 'N' union SELECT DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR, DBAZ.PROD_C, TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_X_DESCR_HOST) AS DESCRIZIONE FROM cll.PROD DBAZ INNER JOIN cat_prod.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT ON DPT.PROD_C = DBAZ.PROD_C INNER JOIN CAT_PROD.ANAG_POL_VITA APV ON trim(APV.COD_PROD_POL_VITA) = TRIM(DPT.PROD_C) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND nvl(TRIM(APV.FLG_PREVD), 'N') = 'N' ) TEMP WHERE 1 = 1 AND COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND PROD_C = CAST(? AS CHAR(11))

Access.Query: SELECT TRIM(DBAZ.PROD_X_DESCR_HOST ) FROM cll.PROD DBAZ INNER JOIN cat_prod.DETT_PROD_TECN DPT ON DPT.PROD_C = DBAZ.PROD_C WHERE 1 = 1 AND DBAZ.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND DPT.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = ? AND DBAZ.PROD_C = cast(? as char(11))

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoPR
Access.Query: SELECT TRIM(P.PROD_X_DESCR_HOST) || ' - ' || TRIM(A.CONTRMUTUI_C_TIPOPIANO_DESCR) FROM CONTRMUTUI A INNER JOIN cll.PROD P ON P.PROD_C = A.PROD_C AND P.PROD_C_CAT = A.CONTRMUTUI_C_CAT AND P.PROD_C_SCAT = A.CONTRMUTUI_C_SCAT WHERE 1=1 AND A.PROD_C = cast('BAN'|| ? as char(11)) AND A.CONTR_N LIKE '001/'||SUBSTR(?,5,8)||'/%'

Access.name: loadArricchimentoContrattoMT
Access.Query: SELECT decode(upper(DES_TIPO_PROD_CONTR),'MUTUI','MUTUO',upper(DES_TIPO_PROD_CONTR)) FROM CAT_PROD.DOM_TIPO_PROD_CONTR where COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = 'MT'
